purpose: Record the ordinal transition rules available to Delta under a declared <S> and residue-asymmetry parameter r_a without assigning numeric step sizes.

local_step.condition: A limited mismatch becomes expressible under the declared coupling.
The declared comparison exposes a stronger but still admissible mismatch.
The declared comparison exposes a strong ordinal mismatch without numeric magnitude.
The declared comparison no longer preserves admissible comparison under the current regime.

reverse_local_step.condition: A prior mismatch is relieved under the same declared comparison regime.
The mismatch expression weakens while staying admissible.
The mismatch expression weakens after a declared update in A, E, <S>, or r_a.

conditions: The trace records an explicit discontinuity.
The substrate or reference coupling changes.

prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume equal interval spacing between classes.
Do not treat one ordinal step as a numeric unit.
Do not read class ordering as a metric line.
Do not infer topology from the ordinal order.
Do not infer physical measurement from the ordinal order.
